tools.name: context_edit
tools.description: Edit your own live context (the CLM mirror). action "list" shows every block's id, role, size and a preview. action "apply" runs ops in order: {op:"replace", id, body} rewrites a block, {op:"delete", id} removes it, {op:"add", body, role?, id?, after?} inserts a notes block (id new-NAME; after a block id, "start", or the end by default), {op:"rewrite", body} replaces everything after the first user message with one notes block. The result becomes your conversation when this turn ends.
